In today's episode of The Daily Brief, we cover two stories shaping Indian and global markets:
Story 1: Reliance’s Strong Start to FY27
Reliance Industries delivered a strong Q1 FY27 despite global supply-chain disruptions and a lower reported profit due to a one-time gain in the base quarter. We break down how its Oil-to-Chemicals, Retail, Jio, and New Energy businesses performed, and what investors should watch in the coming quarters.
